purpose: Map the v78 unemployment rule-regime signal into permanent regressions and the v79 public runtime guard in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system without creating a separate a-kassa app, target engine, mapping pack or truth layer.

mappings.product_miss: The support truth contract and v78 scenario learning distinguish income-based ALF24 from an older ongoing pre-2025-10-01 benefit period, while the legacy person-pilot unemployment result still presented generic arbetsvillkor/work-history semantics. v79 closes that public presentation drift in the same person result pipeline rather than creating a second learning signal or matcher.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Use the existing person/unemployment capability only. A newly unemployed user sees registration with Arbetsförmedlingen on the first unemployed day before generic a-kassa rule detail. A user who already reports receiving a-kassa sees the two-regime boundary first rather than being told to re-register. sv/ar/fa use the same semantic ordering. Existing unemployed+sick and basic-needs/economic-assistance overlaps remain available through the shared result pipeline; the runtime replaces stale presentation only and does not decide matcher truth.
mappings.truth_boundary: Feedback and natural-language discovery are never truth. Current IAF and Arbetsförmedlingen primary guidance plus the relevant a-kassa are required for material unemployment-insurance claims. Do not guarantee eligibility, amount, sanction outcome or deadline, and do not infer the applicable rule regime only from the current calendar date. The canonical support remains human-review gated until material fields are verified.
